description:
Get a DOWNLOAD LINK for a table, as a file: csv, xlsx (Excel), json or parquet -- the whole table, not a page of it: a cleaned table, or a wrangle / sql_query result. The `download_url` opens in a browser or with curl and needs no key.

The link works for ONE HOUR, then stops; a new export call gives a fresh one (the table itself stays for as long as its table_id does). Anyone holding the link can download the file during that hour. The link does not reveal the table_id.

`filename` names the downloaded file (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore); the format's extension is added.

filename.description: name of the downloaded file, without or with the extension

name: export
title: Download a table as a file
